name: Beryl Bender Birch
reason: Too thin once the rules are applied. Her site power-yoga.com (The Hard & The Soft Yoga Institute; email yoga@power-yoga.com, usable photo) lists only two current items: a Xinalani, Mexico retreat (30 Jan - 6 Feb 2027) and an Omega Institute programme (18-23 Jul 2027, a hub programme that counts once); her online meditation series started on 3 Nov 2026 and her teacher trainings were retired in 2023. No YouTube channel is linked from her site, and her books could not be given ISBNs: simonandschuster.com refused us with 403 on the first page (6 Nov 2026), so nothing more was fetched there. Base published only as 'the Berkshires in southwestern Massachusetts'. Owner may want to look: she is the originator of Power Yoga and names Omega on her own site.
